decisions.decision: Use Neon Postgres instead of Supabase
decisions.reason: Preview database branching aligns with Vercel deployment previews.
decisions.tradeoffs: Less realtime tooling than Supabase, but better Vercel-native integration.

decisions.decision: Use GitHub App instead of personal access token
decisions.reason: Scoped permissions, auditable installs, no single-user credential dependency.
decisions.tradeoffs: Higher setup cost but dramatically safer for multi-repo agent access.
